Subject: Records request — processor assurance & transfers

Hi Soojin,

As part of our EU transfer and DPIA review, our privacy team needs a set of processor-side artefacts to close our compliance loop. Specifically we need: 1) a copy of your current DPA Annex (latest version), 2) a record of processing activities export (Art. 30) for Redwood’s processing of Acme data, 3) up-to-date subprocessor inventory with initiation dates and subprocessors that handle EU data, and 4) confirmation of transfer mechanisms (SCCs / adequacy / VPN).

Can you confirm whether you can provide these materials and an expected delivery timeline? We are on a tight calendar for our internal audit — ideally by Friday 2026-10-02. If you prefer to coordinate via your legal partner, please loop them in.

Thanks,

Evelyn Wong
Head of Privacy, Acme Corp
compliance@acme-corp.com

Hi team — attaching the materials I mentioned during the call. What I’m sending now is the working set; we can finalize redlines if Acme needs any DPA changes.

Attachments included (attached to this message):
- redwood-dpa-annex-v3.pdf — current DPA Annex (includes security controls summary and data handling scope)
- subprocessor-inventory-2026-09.csv — names, roles, country, start dates; marked EU-handling flag
- soc2-2026-summary.pdf — high-level report summary (no attest copy)

Notes:
